title: Cobblemoga
description: A lightweight Cobblemon-centered modpack with a little bit of everything.
body:
A small modpack I originally made for friends, now uploaded for all to use.

# Features
- 1000+ Cobblemon species
- QoL Mods for everyone
- 2 difficulty levels through a fair, balanced progression system manually adjusted to be as enjoyable and satisfying as possible.

## Exciting Adventuring
Hundreds of novel strucures to explore. Uncover long-lost loot to strengthen yourself and your Cobblemon team. Level up along with your team as you uncover mighty powers of ancient past.

## Diverse and balanced experience
Varied handpicked mods cover any playstyle, from beginner farmer to veteran adventurer. 
You could fight the forces of evil with your Cobblemons or sit back and cook your favorite dishes. The choice is yours! Optimized to be played with 2-4 players with minimal lag.
